const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboLab block stacking controller for the eai-standard/2.2 service.
+
+The object locations below are measured from the initial calibrated overhead
+RGB-D frame in env-local metres.  The cubes are approximately 4.7 cm tall.
+Run this file once to execute the stack; the episode itself is owned by the
+service and is never reset by this client.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import EpisodeOver, Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "trajectory"
+CAMERAS = ["egocentric_mirrored_camera", "over_shoulder_left_camera", "wrist_cam"]
+
+
+class StackController:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.r = Robot()
+        self.spec = self.r.spec()
+        self.calls = 0
+        self.obs = self.r.get_obs(video="none")
+        self.q = np.asarray(self.obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][11:15], dtype=float)
+        self._snapshot("start", self.obs)
+        print("service", self.r.base, "status", self.r.status(), flush=True)
+        print("initial tcp", self.obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15], flush=True)
+
+    def _snapshot(self, name, result):
+        OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for cam, frame in result.last.items():
+            try:
+                from PIL import Image
+                Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"{self.calls:03d}_{name}_{cam}.jpg", quality=90)
+            except ImportError:
+                np.save(OUT / f"{self.calls:03d}_{name}_{cam}.npy", frame)
+
+    def go(self, x, y, z, gripper, tag):
+        pose = np.r_[float(x), float(y), float(z), self.q, float(gripper)].astype(np.float32)
+        try:
+            res = self.r.submit("ee_pose", pose, cameras=CAMERAS, video="none", note=tag)
+        except Exception as e:
+            # A lost response can follow a completed action. The service owns
+            # the episode state, so reconnect and inspect it before deciding
+            # whether any command needs to be repeated.
+            print("submit exception", repr(e), flush=True)
+            status = self.r.wait_ready()
+            print("service recovered", status, flush=True)
+            raise
+        self.calls += 1
+        self.obs = res
+        self._snapshot(tag.replace(" ", "_"), res)
+        now = res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "tag": tag,
+            "done": res.meta.get("done"),
+            "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+            "plan": res.meta.get("plan"),
+            "clipped": res.meta.get("clipped"),
+            "control_steps_chunk": res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+            "tcp_now": now[8:15] if now else None,
+            "gripper_opening_m": now[24] if len(now) > 24 else None,
+            "status": self.r.status(),
+        }), flush=True)
+        return res
+
+    def transfer(self, name, source_xy, place_bottom_z, tower_xy=(0.461, -0.001),
+                 table_z=0.0035):
+        sx, sy = source_xy
+        tx, ty = tower_xy
+        # The downward-facing finger pads run upward from the TCP by about
+        # 5.7 cm. Put the fingertip centres at each block's bottom face.
+        self.go(sx, sy, 0.145, 0, f"{name} approach")
+        if self.obs.done if hasattr(self.obs, "done") else self.obs.meta.get("done"):
+            return True
+        self.go(sx, sy, table_z + 0.002, 0, f"{name} descend")
+        self.go(sx, sy, table_z + 0.002, 1, f"{name} close")
+        self.go(sx, sy, 0.155, 1, f"{name} lift")
+        self.go(tx, ty, 0.155, 1, f"{name} cross above tower")
+        self.go(tx, ty, place_bottom_z, 1, f"{name} seat on tower")
+        # Let the block rest on the one below before opening.
+        self.go(tx, ty, place_bottom_z, 0, f"{name} release")
+        self.go(tx, ty, min(place_bottom_z + 0.095, 0.265), 0, f"{name} retract")
+        return bool(self.obs.meta.get("done"))
+
+    def execute(self):
+        # Blue is already centered and serves as the bottom block.
+        z_table, cube_h = 0.0035, 0.0468
+        tower_top = z_table + cube_h
+        plan = [
+            ("red", (0.373, -0.175)),
+            ("green", (0.371, 0.187)),
+            ("yellow", (0.478, 0.115)),
+        ]
+        for name, xy in plan:
+            if self.r.status().get("done"):
+                return
+            if self.transfer(name, xy, tower_top, table_z=z_table):
+                return
+            tower_top += cube_h
+        print("all transfer motions completed; status", self.r.status(), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    StackController().execute()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
